objective: Design one coherent visual micro-event that grounds the accepted L000 thesis before any drills, image prompts, or runtime script are written.
story_acceptance_rules: Use one persistent interaction, goal, or uncertainty with a meaningful resolution. Two unrelated exchanges joined by page order fail.
Prefer Ninereeds as the responding participant so every scored first-person answer remains Ninereeds.
The story need not contain every L000 form. Coherence outranks grammar coverage.
The scored world claim is stable supplied names. Phone, screen, and symbol constraints remain visual-safety metadata, not new learner world knowledge.

Comprehension must depend on attending to the event. If L000 lacks language for an ordinary narrative question, use an explicitly typed nonverbal selection or direct story re-entry and state the evidentiary limit honestly.
No scored quoted-character completion and no expected first-person answer as Taro, Emma, Bob, or Errol.
The book is noncanonical instructional material and creates no first meeting, biography, ontology, or chronology update.
required_output: One closed JSON object following story-architecture.template.json and copying required_input_bindings exactly into input_bindings.
decision_rule: Pass only if this is one coherent micro-event, every comprehension response respects L000 identity safety and the selected world objective, and validation passes. Otherwise alarm with the exact conflict.
